ModMetaData.name: Living World
ModMetaData.author: AzraelGodKing
ModMetaData.description:
Off-map faction life: other settlements drift, flip ownership, feud, and make news — without a second storyteller dumping threat at you.
Personal antagonists stay in Nemesis. Player goodwill stays in Deep Colony. Requires Harmony. RimWorld 1.6. Safe to add mid-save.
